title: bolandia glabrifolia
intro: Bolandia glabrifolia, commonly known as the Bolandia plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Gentianaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from infections. Bioactive constituents of Bolandia glabrifolia include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
